draft.suggestedHeadline: US lifts 50% tariffs on some Canadian goods two weeks before midterms
draft.summary: The White House confirmed on Friday that 50% tariffs will be eased on a range of Canadian goods — including plywood sheets, some paper products, certain machinery, refrigeration equipment and some packing crates and boxes — from 30 October. New tariffs will meanwhile be placed on carpets and "waste products". Republican Senator Susan Collins had announced the exemptions first; she is in a tight re-election race in Maine, whose blueberry, potato, apple and seaweed producers depend on cross-border trade with Canada.
